description:
Make archive preview and candidate listing compute their plans with the planner that archive execution uses, through the read driver, which captures and plans without the repository lock, so a preview reports exactly the plan execute would apply over the same image (`@/charter/D-20`, `@/charter/D-22`). In the same change, move the no-follow artifact inspector and the citation scan into their own storage module, re-home the archive discovery tests onto the pure domain discovery, and delete the storage-only archive planning code the preview pipeline used.

## Background

- Preview has its own planner. `preview_archive_document` and `preview_archive_container` (`crates/jit/src/commands/archive.rs:173-182`) and `archive_candidates` (`archive.rs:158-170`) call `plan_archive_target` (`archive.rs:184-309`, in `impl<S: IssueStore> CommandExecutor<S>` at `:155`). It repeats the execute planner `capture_archive_plan` (`archive.rs:511-833`, in `impl CommandExecutor<JsonFileStorage>` at `:510`) step for step: configuration, hierarchy, issues, target resolution, policy, destination, inventory remap, pinned evidence, discovery, blockers, classification facts, residue identities and classification. The preview reads through `IssueStore`, disk and the storage-only helpers (`crate::storage::resolve_container_destination`, `discover_archive_artifacts`, `collect_artifact_classification_facts`); execute reads one captured image.
- Reads run through `with_read_session` (`crates/jit/src/commands/mod.rs`, next to `with_mutation_session` at `:455`), whose closure takes `&mut dyn RepositoryReadSession`; a mutation session coerces to that trait. `capture_archive_base` (`crates/jit/src/commands/validate.rs:305`) already sits in the generic `impl<S: IssueStore + RepositoryStateStore>` block, and `InMemoryStorage` implements `RepositoryStateStore`.
- The preview resolves pinned documents through `inventory_issues_pinned_evidence` (`archive.rs:90-105`, after the git-module work one object reader on the invocation's checkout) and reads prior executions through the per-target evidence-record read method of `IssueStore`; execute captures both in the image (batched pinned requests through the capture, the target's evidence record from the image).
- Citation evidence is read outside the image by `crate::storage::collect_citation_scan_evidence` (`archive.rs:813`, re-exported `pub(crate)` at `crates/jit/src/storage/mod.rs:52`), advisory by design; preview and execute share it.
- `crates/jit/src/storage/artifact_planning.rs` mixes three things: the storage-only archive planners (`resolve_container_destination` `:28-81`, `collect_artifact_classification_facts` `:83-145`, re-exported at `storage/mod.rs:53`), the citation scan `collect_citation_scan_evidence` (`:163-198`, with `read_scanned_file` `:200-214` and `PermissionDeniedPolicy` `:216-243`), and the no-follow inspector `inspect_artifact_evidence` (`:246-257`) with `inspect_artifact_evidence_with_policy`, `inspect_artifact_from_root`, `list_immediate_children`, `list_recursive` and `child_path` (`:259-447`).
- The scan and the inspector have callers outside archive preview: document listing calls `crate::storage::artifact_planning::inspect_artifact_evidence` (`crates/jit/src/commands/document.rs:135`, `list_issue_scoped_areas`); `JsonFileStorage::inspect_artifact_location` (`crates/jit/src/storage/json.rs:684-707`) wraps it for one test (`json.rs:293-338`); and `storage/artifact_discovery.rs:14,77` uses it. The inspector walks with the shared no-follow primitives (`open_child_dir_nofollow`, `open_regular_file_nofollow`, `open_absolute_dir_nofollow`) in `crates/jit/src/storage/capability_fs.rs`.
- The citation tests build their plan through the test helper `plan_with_scan` (`artifact_planning.rs:501-532`), which calls the storage-only planner `collect_artifact_classification_facts` (`:521`) before `classify_artifacts`. Owning tests in `artifact_planning.rs`: `test_inspect_artifact_evidence_distinguishes_complete_listing_scopes_without_following_symlinks` (`:564`) and four `test_collect_citation_scan_evidence_*` tests (`:630-709`).
- `crates/jit/tests/fast_docs_templates/artifact_discovery_tests.rs` (844 lines, registered at `crates/jit/tests/fast_docs_templates/main.rs:7`) builds a `JsonFileStorage` over a temporary repository (`Repo`, `artifact_discovery_tests.rs:55-116`) and calls `crate::storage::discover_archive_artifacts` (`:101`, `:693`, `:723`). Its tests own the format matrix (HTML, CSS, Markdown edges, dynamic-loading warnings, `:165-655`), repository-escape and missing-target handling (`:311`), navigation link targets (`:350`, `:392`), pinned roots (`:680`, `:711`) and symlinked sources and ancestors (`:739`, `:773`, `:807`).
- The storage wrapper (`crates/jit/src/storage/artifact_discovery.rs:41-86`, `ArtifactDiscoveryError` and `collect_closure_evidence` at `:21-86`, re-exported at `storage/mod.rs:51`) only loops `expand_artifact_closure` (`crates/jit/src/domain/artifact_discovery.rs:232`) over evidence read with the no-follow inspector, then calls the domain `discover_archive_artifacts` (`domain/artifact_discovery.rs:314`). Every property above is a property of the domain functions over evidence: a symlinked path reaches them as `ArtifactEvidence::Symlink`, a directory as `ArtifactEvidence::Directory`. That the inspector itself reports a symlink without following it is owned by the inspector's own tests in storage. `test_terminal_evidence_closes_without_parsing_or_more_needs` (`artifact_discovery_tests.rs:38`) already exercises the domain directly.
- Harness callers over `InMemoryStorage`: `tests/fast_issue/short_hash_tests.rs:319-321` (container preview by short id) and `tests/fast_docs_templates/harness_demo.rs:485-537` (candidates), which writes `config.toml` to disk (`:494-500`) where a memory-backend capture does not see it. `crates/jit/src/commands/test_helpers.rs:16` `seed_repo_file` is crate-private; the shared harness `crates/jit/src/test_harness.rs` has no repository-file seeder.
- Execute entry points: `execute_archive_document` and `execute_archive_container` (`archive.rs:836,841`), through `execute_archive_target` (`:847`). CLI callers: `crates/jit/src/main.rs:5144,5161`; signatures stay.
- Public items without callers once preview moves, deleted explicitly because the zero-warning build does not flag public items: the `IssueStore` method that reads one archive target's evidence record, its file-backend and memory-backend implementations, and its forwarders in the two integration-test store wrappers (`crates/jit/tests/fast_docs_templates/template_apply_atomicity_tests.rs`, `crates/jit/tests/fast_rules/local_rule_enforcement_tests.rs`). The modules are declared at `storage/mod.rs:12-13`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `preview_archive_document`, `preview_archive_container` and `archive_candidates` obtain every plan from `capture_archive_plan`, which takes `&mut dyn RepositoryReadSession`, through `with_read_session`, and execute calls the same function through `with_mutation_session`; `plan_archive_target` and the preview-only pinned-evidence helper no longer exist, and the planner and previews live in one `impl<S: IssueStore + RepositoryStateStore>` block.
- [hard] REQ-02: A command test owns preview-equals-execute: over one seeded repository it calls `preview_archive_document` and `preview_archive_container`, then `execute_archive_document` and `execute_archive_container` on the same unchanged repository, and asserts that each previewed plan agrees with what the execution applied: the previewed destination root equals `ArchiveExecutionResult::destination_root`, the previewed move and copy entries are exactly the result's `publications` sources, and the previewed move entries are exactly its `planned_deletions`. It does not call the planner itself; the execution result (`crates/jit/src/domain/artifact_execution.rs:24`) is the independent side.
- [hard] REQ-03: The harness preview and candidates tests run over `InMemoryStorage` with their configuration seeded through a public `crates/jit/src/test_harness.rs` repository-file seeder, and the existing preview CLI tests in `crates/jit/tests/cli_repo_workflow/archive_preview_cli_tests.rs` pass unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-04: `crates/jit/src/storage/artifact_inspection.rs` defines `inspect_artifact_evidence` with its walker and `collect_citation_scan_evidence` with its permission policy, built on the `capability_fs` primitives; archive execute, document listing and the other callers use them, the five owning tests run there with unchanged assertions, the relocated test helper builds its facts by calling `collect_citation_scan_evidence` directly, and the symlink no-follow property that `json.rs:293-338` asserts through `inspect_artifact_location` is asserted against `inspect_artifact_evidence`, with `inspect_artifact_location` and its test gone.
- [hard] REQ-05: Each property the `artifact_discovery_tests.rs` tests assert is owned by exactly one test that drives `expand_artifact_closure` and the domain `discover_archive_artifacts` over an in-memory evidence map built through one shared helper, no test calls `crate::storage::discover_archive_artifacts`, the storage `Repo` fixture is gone, the symlink cases assert the domain outcome for `ArtifactEvidence::Symlink` at the root, at an ancestor and at an embedded artifact with the same expected plan entries as today, and the tests pass alone and in parallel.
- [hard] REQ-06: `crates/jit/src/storage/artifact_planning.rs` and `crates/jit/src/storage/artifact_discovery.rs` no longer exist and `storage/mod.rs` declares and re-exports nothing from them; no `IssueStore` method reads an archive target's evidence record (the method, both backend implementations and both test-wrapper forwarders are gone); the workspace builds without warnings and the archive preview, execute and candidate tests pass unchanged.

## Notes

- Behaviour change: preview and `archive candidates` read through the read driver: lock-free while uncontended, under the repository lock after bounded refusals, completing a leftover redo record only then; they still publish nothing. Pinned evidence comes from the capture's batched request, so a memory backend reports pinned documents as unavailable. Asserted by the non-mutation tests and the unchanged non-mutation tests (`test_preview_container_is_deterministic_complete_and_non_mutating`, `archive.rs:1831`).
- Candidates still open one session per candidate here; `archive-candidates-one-session` folds them into one session.
- The inspector and scan move, the discovery test relocation and the planner removal change no behaviour; the relocated tests may live in `crates/jit/src/domain/artifact_discovery.rs`'s test module or stay in the integration file as domain-only tests, either way without production edits.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Archive preview runs the execute planner read-only
